facts.fact: Gemnation reports that the Citizens Engagement and Scoring Platform, launched by President Mnangagwa on 18 June 2026, has a built-in AI model that analysed live Harare council scores and produced a recommendation.

systems.owner: Ministry of Local Government and Public Works / Harare Institute of Technology

ZWE.note: The AI model scores council services for administration, not a named sector system.
Says the platform has a built-in AI model but not who built it or where it runs.
Only reports a score from 19 participants with disabilities; no accessibility rule or service.
Names LADS applications and a WhatsApp chatbot; states no office connection.

facts.fact: Gemnation reports LADS, with mobile revenue collection, the e-Musika app and e-business licensing, is deployed to 53 councils, with better revenue collection and less leakage reported in Mutare, Masvingo and Chinhoyi.
Gemnation reports LADS has been deployed to 53 councils, with no total number of councils given.
